<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 428 886">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="428" height="886" rx="40" fill="#F6F6F6"/>
  <rect x="18" y="18" width="392" height="850" rx="32" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  
  <g id="status-bar">
    <text x="42" y="52" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
    <line x1="336" y1="48" x2="336" y2="52" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="341" y1="46" x2="341" y2="52" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="346" y1="44" x2="346" y2="52" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="362" cy="49" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="358" y1="45" x2="366" y2="53" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <rect x="377" y="44" width="19" height="10" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <rect x="396" y="47" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="380" y="47" width="12" height="4" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
  </g>

  <g id="top-bar">
    <polyline points="46,91 38,99 46,107" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="64" y="104" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Kembali</text>
    <circle cx="365" cy="99" r="17" fill="#69ABDF"/>
    <text x="365" y="106" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="21" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">f</text>
  </g>

  <g id="intro">
    <text x="214" y="163" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Syne, sans-serif" font-size="30" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Shirlou</text>
    <text x="214" y="193" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#8F8F8F">Login dengan Facebook</text>
  </g>

  <g id="permission-card">
    <rect x="48" y="219" width="332" height="365" rx="22" fill="#000000" opacity="0.08"/>
    <rect x="48" y="216" width="332" height="365" rx="22" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E8E6EA" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="214" cy="266" r="33" fill="#000000"/>
    <text x="214" y="280" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Syne, sans-serif" font-size="42" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">S</text>
    <text x="214" y="328" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Shirlou meminta izin</text>
    <text x="214" y="351" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#8F8F8F">untuk mengakses akun Facebook Anda</text>
    
    <line x1="78" y1="375" x2="350" y2="375" stroke="#E8E6EA" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="78" y="405" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Informasi yang dibagikan</text>
    
    <circle cx="91" cy="435" r="12" fill="#DEF4FF"/>
    <circle cx="91" cy="431" r="4" fill="#2A5E70"/>
    <ellipse cx="91" cy="440" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#2A5E70"/>
    <text x="115" y="440" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Nama dan foto profil</text>
    
    <circle cx="91" cy="473" r="12" fill="#EEE4D8"/>
    <rect x="85" y="468" width="12" height="9" rx="2" fill="#A5503C"/>
    <circle cx="91" cy="466" r="2" fill="#A5503C"/>
    <text x="115" y="478" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Alamat email</text>
    
    <line x1="78" y1="502" x2="350" y2="502" stroke="#E8E6EA" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="78" y="531" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#8F8F8F">Anda dapat mengubah akses kapan saja dari</text>
    <text x="78" y="547" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#8F8F8F">pengaturan akun Facebook.</text>
  </g>

  <g id="account">
    <circle cx="86" cy="624" r="26" fill="#000000"/>
    <text x="86" y="634" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Syne, sans-serif" font-size="27" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">S</text>
    <text x="126" y="620" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Melanjutkan sebagai Kevin</text>
    <text x="126" y="640" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#8F8F8F">kevin.martin@email.com</text>
    <rect x="324" y="614" width="31" height="20" rx="10" fill="#F6F6F6"/>
    <polyline points="335,621 341,627 347,621" fill="none" stroke="#8F8F8F" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>

  <g id="actions">
    <rect x="48" y="678" width="332" height="48" rx="24" fill="#69ABDF"/>
    <text x="214" y="708" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Lanjutkan sebagai Kevin</text>
    
    <rect x="48" y="738" width="158" height="42" rx="21" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <text x="127" y="764" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Edit Akses</text>
    
    <rect x="222" y="738" width="158" height="42" rx="21" fill="#F6F6F6"/>
    <text x="301" y="764" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#8F8F8F">Batal</text>
  </g>

  <g id="legal">
    <text x="214" y="807" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="9" font-weight="400" fill="#8F8F8F">Dengan melanjutkan, Anda menyetujui Ketentuan dan</text>
    <text x="214" y="822" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="9" font-weight="400" fill="#8F8F8F">Kebijakan Privasi Shirlou.</text>
  </g>

  <g id="navigation-bar">
    <line x1="42" y1="840" x2="386" y2="840" stroke="#E8E6EA" stroke-width="1"/>
    <polygon points="75,851 66,859 66,870 84,870 84,859" fill="none" stroke="#8F8F8F" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <polyline points="63,859 75,849 87,859" fill="none" stroke="#8F8F8F" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <text x="75" y="882" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="8" font-weight="500" fill="#8F8F8F">Beranda</text>
    
    <circle cx="161" cy="858" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#8F8F8F" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <circle cx="157" cy="856" r="2" fill="#8F8F8F"/>
    <circle cx="165" cy="856" r="2" fill="#8F8F8F"/>
    <text x="161" y="882" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="8" font-weight="500" fill="#8F8F8F">Komunitas</text>
    
    <rect x="235" y="850" width="18" height="14" rx="5" fill="none" stroke="#8F8F8F" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <polygon points="239,864 239,869 245,864" fill="#8F8F8F"/>
    <circle cx="241" cy="857" r="1" fill="#8F8F8F"/>
    <circle cx="247" cy="857" r="1" fill="#8F8F8F"/>
    <text x="244" y="882" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="8" font-weight="500" fill="#8F8F8F">Pesan</text>
    
    <circle cx="330" cy="855" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#8F8F8F" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <ellipse cx="330" cy="868" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#8F8F8F" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <text x="330" y="882" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="8" font-weight="500" fill="#8F8F8F">Profil</text>
  </g>
</svg>
